entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Legendary king of Akros on Theros, a brilliant tactician and warrior, husband of Cymede; later reforged by Purphoros into a demigod.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Wife of King Anax of Akros; missing but not presumed dead.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City and kingdom on Theros ruled by Anax.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane on which Akros lies.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God Anax followed in his earlier years.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God Anax turned to in later years, who reforged him into a demigod.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Planeswalker who besieged Akros and used the victory celebration to become the Great Revel and ascend to godhood.

entities.name: Rhordon the Rageblood
entities.description: Oracle of Mogis who fought Anax and impaled him.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of Slaughter who gave a boon to Rhordon.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God who aided Cymede and whose river elemental washed Rhordon away.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who sensed Mogis's interference and saved Anax.

entities.name: Taranika
entities.description: Niece of Anax and Cymede who served as regent of Akros.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: The celebration Xenagos used to ascend to godhood.

events.summary: Xenagos and his forces lay siege to Akros; Anax fights Rhordon, who is aided by Mogis, and is impaled.
events.quote: The Rageblood quickly defeated Anax by impaling the king through the stomach.

events.summary: Elspeth saves Anax and Rhordon is washed away by Keranos's river elemental.
events.quote: Elspeth stepped forward and saved Anax

events.summary: Anax insists the victory celebration continue, which Xenagos uses to become the Great Revel.
events.quote: This celebration was used by Xenagos to become the Great Revel he needed to ascend to godhood.

events.summary: Anax dies within two years, possibly of his injuries.
events.quote: He died sometime in the following two years, possibly due to his injuries.

events.summary: During the war between the gods, Purphoros reforges Anax into a demigod who can only say 'Cymede'.
events.quote: During the war between the gods, Purphoros transformed Anax, reforging him into a demigod who can't think of anything but victory.

events.summary: With Cymede missing, Taranika serves as regent of Akros.
events.quote: the responsibility of leadership fell to their niece, Taranika

relations.quote: He was the husband of Cymede
Anax ( /ænæks/ ) was the legendary king of Akros on Theros
King Anax went forth in combat against Rhordon the Rageblood

relations.note: turned to Purphoros in later years
relations.quote: he turned to Purphoros as he steered his people
